db1907a0.name: Option Generation — AI Breadth vs Human Brainstorming
db1907a0.description: Compare number and quality of decision options generated by AI option_generator vs human brainstorming session.

hypothesis.statement: AI option generation produces ≥2x more distinct viable options than unaided human brainstorming

34b4616c.name: Bias Detection — Pre-Mortem vs Post-Decision Review
34b4616c.description: Measure bias incidence rate in decisions reviewed with pre-mortem analysis vs standard post-decision review.

hypothesis.statement: Pre-mortem analysis reduces identifiable cognitive bias incidence by ≥25%

d9a40b51.name: Regret Minimisation — 10-10-10 Rule Application
d9a40b51.description: Test whether applying the 10-10-10 temporal regret framework improves long-term satisfaction scores for major decisions.

hypothesis.statement: 10-10-10 rule application improves 6-month post-decision satisfaction by ≥20%
